senses.sense_definition: Systeem dat beschermt tegen aanvallende raketten.

examples.text: De huidige <w>raketafweer</w> is niet in staat om deze nieuwe supersonische projectielen te onderscheppen.

target_lang_translations.en: The current <w>anti-missile defence</w> is unable to intercept these new supersonic projectiles.

examples.text: De meeste raketten werden succesvol onderschept door de <w>raketafweer</w> van het land.

target_lang_translations.en: Most missiles were successfully intercepted by the country's <w>missile defense</w>.

target_lang_definitions.en: A system designed to protect against incoming missiles.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: General term for systems used to intercept missiles.
Common term used in military and political contexts.
